subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should #38364 remain open as the combined tracker for structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split/close it in favor of #90745, #88032, and #87561?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol, agent runtime context, Telegram/channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep #38364 open while #90745 or a replacement defines reply metadata and #87561 owns final fallback/no-output delivery semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm #90745 or #88032 fully owns reply metadata and #87561 fully owns the no-output half.

options.title: Accept Quote Text As Enough
options.body: Treat current Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI replies, which narrows scope but leaves the original structured metadata ask unmet.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep #38364 open while #90745 or a replacement defines reply metadata and #87561 owns final fallback/no-output delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the broadest available routing owner from the issue timeline and current-main cross-surface history; concrete implementation ownership is shared.
